spec.scope: Flat damage proc, 167.45% of final ATK, plain flavor ('as damage' — no distributed/sustained wording). Rider rules: noRange forced (engine default for riders), crits only if modeled crit-eligible (default OFF), takes the +50% FB major by LANDING TIMING (default ON for function damage)

spec.kitLine: ATK ▲ 6.16% of the skill user's final Max HP

spec.durationSemantics: 'at the start of battle … continuously' = passive, always-on, whole fight; the conversion must re-read live Max HP (or be re-applied on each HP change), not snapshot base HP at t=0

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in order of likelihood: (1) SKILL1 IS NOT DEFENSIVE — the Max HP tiers are the kit's ATK ramp because skill2 converts FINAL Max HP to ATK at 6.16%; a driver who marks skill1 UNMODELED/'no damage relevance' or whose conversion snapshots base HP at t=0 deletes up to +87.85%-of-conversion late-fight ATK. The withPatchedOverride A/B (skill1 zeroed → totalDamage must drop) is the single highest-leverage test. (2) burstCast vs fullBurstEnter on skill1 is LIVE in this fixture: controlComp includes helm as a second Burst III, so team FBs occur without 2b casting — count stacks against 2b's burstCast events, not fullBurstStart events. (3) Escalation arithmetic: 'Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' → cumulative 87.85% after three uses (assert not 57.76% replace-only, not ≥118% double-count), plateau thereafter; 'continuously' = permanent, never a 10s window. (4) Both burst hits are burst-cast-timed → fbMajorApplied false; the 792% hit must stay a separate plain-flavor effect, not merged into the distributed 2439.36%. (5) skill2's 300-count is a hitCount trigger tied to her shot events (spans reloads), not an interval; it repeats every 300 rounds. Ordering caveat worth a note in the override (not an assertion): whether the Nth burst's OWN 2439.36/792 hits already benefit from the Nth skill1 HP tier via the conversion is a same-frame ordering convention — flag ⚑ if the driver pins it either way without a measurement. All magnitudes are kit-literal (DATAMINED); the only ALWAYS-⚑ field in play is the base cadence tuple, which is fixture-level, not a spec line.
